sections.title: Professional introduction
sections.body:
Anameka S Panda is a graphologist and graphotherapist, handwriting and signature analyst, occult practitioner and life transformation coach based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

Her work spans Vedic astrology, Vastu, numerology and logo analysis, and a growing focus on students: she created the Exam Ready From the Inside and Student Inner Excellence programmes, and trains teachers through the Child Script Coach™ and Handwriting Mastery programmes.

sections.title: Professional philosophy
sections.body:
In Anameka's own words:

No complicated theory, just real tools that work for real people.
A child's behaviour is a message, not the problem.

She works from the inside out: understanding a person first, often through their handwriting, and then offering practical, no-fear guidance that fits into daily life.

sections.title: Who she works with
sections.body:
• Students and parents: exam confidence, focus and study habits through her student programmes.
  • Teachers and schools: handwriting analysis training and one-to-one consultations.
  • Business owners: logo analysis, mobile number numerology and Vastu for premises.
  • Individuals and families: Vedic astrology, Astro-Vastu, remedies and life coaching.
